attchmntText: Bajaj Consumer Care Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations, please find attached details of order passed by Dy. Commission of State Tax, Udaipur, Rajasthan'.
voiceSummary: Bajaj Consumer Care Limited disclosed an order dated 23 November 2026 from the Deputy Commercial Tax Officer, Udaipur, Rajasthan. The order demands tax of Rs. 17,46,092 for ineligible Input Tax Credit claimed under the GST Act. A penalty of Rs. 1,94,610 and interest of Rs. 6,54,425 under Section 50 of the CGST Act, 2017, have also been levied. The company states there is no impact on its financial, operational, or other activities due to this alleged tax demand. The order is appealable, and the company is contesting it at a higher appellate level.

attchmntText: Sumeet Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Sumeet Industries submitted the transcript of its earnings conference call held on November 20, 2026, to discuss un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Revenue from operations rose to INR 364 crores in Q2 FY27, up 35.23% year-on-year. EBITDA margin stood at 2.53% in Q2, down from 5.39% in the prior year, due to narrowed material cost spreads. Profit after tax was INR 4.40 crores in Q2, compared to INR 9.86 crores last year. Net worth nearly doubled to INR 417 crores from INR 211 crores in March. Borrowings decreased to INR 137 crores from INR 160 crores. Cash reserves increased to INR 160 crores from INR 38 crores. The company completed a right issue with net proceeds of INR 194.9 crores, utilized for working capital, Nakoda asset integration, and debt repayment. A 12-megawatt solar project is expected to be commissioned by December 2026.

attchmntText: ShreeOswal Seeds And Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication about information of postal ballot
voiceSummary: Shreeoswal Seeds and Chemicals Limited has published a public notice in the Free Press Journal, Indore, Free Press Journal, Mumbai, and Choutha Sansar, Indore, regarding the dispatch of the Postal Ballot Notice and remote e-voting information. The e-voting period is scheduled from the 16th of October, 2026, to the 18th of October, 2026. The final date for e-voting is the 18th of October, 2026, at 5:00 PM. The company states that the results of the Postal Ballot are awaited. This filing is made in compliance with Regulation 47 of the SEBI LODR Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: EPL Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 75399 securities pursuant to ESOP/ESPS at its meeting held on November 23, 2026
voiceSummary: EPL Limited has informed the stock exchanges regarding the allotment of 75,399 equity shares following the exercise of stock options under the Employee Stock Option Scheme 2020. The company clarified that this allotment is not material in nature. The information is available on the company website.

attchmntText: Ventive Hospitality Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Ventive Hospitality Limited filed an intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations regarding an investor presentation at Blackstone Connect 2026 on November 24, 2026, in Mumbai. The company confirmed that no unpublished price sensitive information will be shared during the meeting. The presentation outlines the company's strategy as India's largest luxury-focused hospitality platform, detailing operations across India, Maldives, and Sri Lanka. Key financial metrics for FY26 include revenue from operations of Rs. 2,461 Cr and operating EBITDA of Rs. 1,094 Cr. The company presented a Vision 2031 target to double operating EBITDA to Rs. 2,000–2,200 Cr by FY31. The pipeline includes 421 owned keys and 1,114 ROFO keys, with incremental capex of Rs. 1,400 Cr. The presentation is available on the company website.

attchmntText: Kalpataru Limited has informed the Exchange about the receipt of Regional Director confirmation Order for the Scheme of Arrangement (Merger by Absorption) of Kalpataru Hills Residency Private Limited, a step-down wholly-owned subsidiary with Kalpataru Properties (Thane) Limited, a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company
voiceSummary: Kalpataru Limited confirms receipt of the Regional Director confirmation order dated November 18, 2026, approving the Scheme of Arrangement for the merger by absorption of Kalpataru Hills Residency Private Limited with Kalpataru Properties Thane Limited. The order was filed with the Registrar of Companies Mumbai-I on November 23, 2026, making the Scheme effective on that date. Consequently, Kalpataru Hills Residency Private Limited stands dissolved and ceases to be a step-down subsidiary of Kalpataru Limited. The merger is sanctioned under Section 233 of the Companies Act 2013 with an appointed date of April 1, 2026. The Transferor Company held 18,00,000 equity shares of Rs. 10 each as of March 31, 2026.

attchmntText: Bharti Airtel Limited has informed the Exchange about Action(s) taken or orders passed

attchmntText: Fujiyama Power Systems Limited has submitted to the Exchange a copy of Scrutinizer's report of Postal Ballot along with the voting results.
voiceSummary: Fujiyama Power Systems Limited announces the results of the Postal Ballot held via Remote E-voting. The voting period ran from October 23, 2026, to November 21, 2026. Scrutinizer Mr. Raghav Bansal submitted his report on November 23, 2026. The resolution to approve raising funds through Qualified Institutions Placement was passed by the members. The resolution required a Special Resolution. Total votes polled were 27,23,85,411. Votes in favor were 27,23,83,644, representing 99.999 percent. Votes against were 1,767, representing 0.001 percent. The resolution is deemed passed on November 21, 2026. The company has disclosed these results to the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited.

attchmntText: Horizon Industrial Parks Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Horizon Industrial Parks Limited filed a presentation for the 2026 Blackstone Connect investor conference held on November 24, 2026. The company is India's number one industrial and logistics infrastructure platform with a total network of 61 million square feet across 46 assets. The stabilized portfolio occupancy stands at 94 percent. The company targets leasing 6.5 million square feet and developing 6 million square feet in fiscal year 2027. Contracted revenue addition for the first half of fiscal year 2027 reached Rs 125 crore. The in-city portfolio redevelopment commenced in September 2025. The first multi-storey asset launch is planned for the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2027. The company holds a 45-year partnership with CWC for its in-city sites. Run-rate revenue is projected to grow 2.7 times to Rs 2,700 crore once the 100 million square foot portfolio is fully built.
